name: _skeleton.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_skeleton.scss — skeleton placeholder surfaces: the shimmer sweep
//  keyframes and the .skeleton block/round/media variants painted from
//  the --skel-bg-* tokens while real content loads.
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Skeleton shimmer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Uses project palette greys, lighter tones, subtler animation.
@keyframes skeleton-shimmer {
  0% {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateX(100%);
  }
}

// Skeleton placeholder shimmer surface (the base visual — animation is the skeleton-shimmer keyframes).
.skeleton {
  display: inline-block;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--skel-bg-1);
  border-radius: var(--space-xs);

  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    // A crisp sweep line, not a wide soft band — the broad gradient
    // feathered the whole surface and read as blur.
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      transparent 42%,
      var(--skel-bg-2) 48%,
      var(--skel-bg-2) 52%,
      transparent 58%,
      transparent 100%
    );
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    will-change: transform;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &--block {
    display: block;
  }
  &--round {
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  // Image-placeholder skeleton: fill the render-placeholder SVG slot
  &--media {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 0;
  }
}
